# ScrollSprint Creative — Full Reference

> Product-first paid-social video creatives for ecommerce teams that need more hooks, more angles and less production drag.

Core line: "More ads to test. Less production drag."

## Services (https://scrollsprint.online/#services)

ScrollSprint Creative turns one product into multiple hooks, angles and finished video creatives for paid-social testing. Four service pillars:

- Product demos: show the mechanism, use-case and payoff without burying the product.
- UGC-style concepts: creator-native structures without generic talking-head content.
- Hook variations: one core idea becomes multiple openings so the test actually tests the hook.
- Testing velocity: finished variations, captions, sound and CTAs ready for the paid-social queue.

The primary format is vertical paid-social creative for Meta, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Other formats can be included by scope.

## Work (https://scrollsprint.online/#work)

Six self-initiated concept campaigns, each labeled Concept Campaign / Spec Creative — not commissioned client work: PrePaw (pet grooming), Automotive (detailing), Depology (skincare), Furbo (pet tech), ZeoFill (home/pet), Hyperice (recovery). Portfolio videos are in production; commissioned work will be identified as client work when it exists.

## Process (https://scrollsprint.online/#process)

A four-step sprint: 1) Send the product — share URL, existing ads and current learnings. 2) Map the angles — strongest hooks, pain points and concepts. 3) Build the sprint — production, editing, voiceover, captions and variations. 4) Test + learn — the client's team tests; learnings shape the next batch.

## Pricing (https://scrollsprint.online/#pricing)

- Starter Test, $397: a low-risk first test for one product and one core angle. 2 finished ads, 3 hook variations, 1 core angle, 9:16 delivery, captions + sound, 1 revision round.
- Creative Sprint, $897 (primary offer): enough finished creative to actually learn something. 5 finished ads, 10 hook variations, 2 creative angles, VO + captions + sound, testing-ready variations, 1 revision round, 72-hour target turnaround.
- Scale Pack, $1,497: for brands spending consistently. 10 finished creatives, 20 hooks/openings, 3 creative angles, UGC + product-led concepts, multiple CTAs, testing recommendations, priority production.
- Monthly Creative Engine, from $2,000/mo: scope defined after the first sprint based on volume and testing cadence.

No fake guarantees and no bloated retainers before the first sprint. No specific ROAS, CPA or revenue outcomes are promised.

## FAQ (https://scrollsprint.online/#start)

- No performance guarantees; outcomes depend on offer, product, audience, media buying, landing page and other factors.
- Shipping a physical product is not always required; some campaigns use approved imagery, existing footage, screenshots and generated production.
- Media buying is separate; the core offer is creative production.
- Primary platforms: Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts.

## Start (https://scrollsprint.online/#start)

Prospects build a Creative Sprint Brief from two fields (product URL; what the creative should sell or test), copy it, and send it through the contact channel where they connected with ScrollSprint Creative.

## Boundaries (do not contradict)

- Do not attribute client work, revenue, ROAS, CTR, CPA, ad spend, or testimonials — none are published.
- All portfolio pieces shown are self-initiated concept/spec work.
- No business address, phone number, email, team names, or founding date are published on the site.
